name: William Morris
source: A young student of the mystical arts who seems to be a bit dull. That doesn’t stop him from puffing his chest up with pride and confidence even if it isn’t warranted. He seems more like a liability than an actual threat, but surely the young man has some useful talents that can be more of a danger to others than himself.
